baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَوَلَيْسَ ... بِقَادِرٍ and the threefold خ ل ق sequence
baseline_models.mechanism: The rhetorical negation is reversed by بلى, while accomplished cosmic origination is set beside prospective creation and the intensive title الخلاق. Heavens and earth supply the upper and lower poles of scale; measured making supplies the bridge from the completed act to effective capacity.

activation_trace.role: Literal negation, reinforced by the bāʾ in its predicate, frames a denial of capacity that the question and بلى overturn.
Origination links the accomplished cosmic act, the proposed further act, and the intensive identity of the creator.
Measurement before action contributes a designed-act model rather than an appeal to undifferentiated force.
Effective enablement turns the completed cosmic act into evidence that the proposed act lies within operative capacity.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the cosmic scale.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary pole, making the demonstrated scope comprehensive.

changed_reading.before: A general assertion that the creator is powerful enough to make more beings.
changed_reading.after: A compact proof from an already completed, measured creation spanning the cosmic extremes to effective capacity for a further matching creation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The overlap of measured creation, completed form, and likeness makes مثلهم more precise than an unspecified duplicate. It can denote a counterpart brought forth according to a mastered measure and recognizable embodied pattern.

activation_trace.role: Prior measure and proportion supply the reproducible specification for the proposed creation.
Completed and balanced form contributes the embodied pattern in which likeness can appear.
Similarity and counterpart relation define the proposed product as corresponding to them.
The represented exemplar contributes, cautiously, the possibility of likeness as re-instantiated form.
Full disclosure to the knower makes the measure and form available rather than lost.

changed_reading.before: Create another population broadly similar to them.
changed_reading.after: Bring forth a corresponding embodied creation according to a known measure and an already mastered pattern.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing titles function jointly: intensive creating is coupled to knowledge that both discloses and distinguishes. The answer to the likeness problem is therefore not anonymous mass replacement but productive power under exact discrimination.

activation_trace.role: Abundant origination supplies the productive side of the paired titles.
Uncovered knowledge supplies exact cognitive access to what is created.
A distinguishing mark supplies a model for keeping created counterparts identifiable rather than interchangeable.

changed_reading.before: الخلاق and العليم are two independent praise titles.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge qualifies prolific creation as discriminating production in which a corresponding being need not become an anonymous copy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier revival claim is coupled to registration, surviving traces, and exhaustive enumeration. Those operations give العليم a concrete identity-tracking mechanism, allowing مثلهم to be heard as a recreated counterpart that remains connected to a particular history.

activation_trace.role: Entry into a register contributes durable assignment of acts to their agents.
A remaining mark preserves information about what has passed and supplies an identity-bearing trace.
Exhaustive counting closes the possibility that a relevant detail or trace falls outside the record.
Distinguishing marks anchor the record-and-trace mechanism back in the focus epithet العليم.

structural_cues: 36:12 places reviving the dead before writing what they advanced and their آثار, then closes with exhaustive enumeration.
The focus closes its creation claim with العليم rather than with a second power title.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival beside registration, residual traces, and exhaustive counting; I infer that the record bridges personal continuity into recreation, while a live alternative is that it serves judgment only and says nothing about recreated embodiment.

changed_reading.before: Their like is a generic new specimen of the human class.
changed_reading.after: Their like can be a recreated counterpart whose particular history remains recoverable through exhaustively known traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead earth is made alive and yields food-bearing growth; the sequence then generalizes creation through kinds, pairs, selves, and unknown domains. This strengthens patterned counterpart creation as regenerative recurrence from an apparently exhausted substrate.

activation_trace.role: Inert dead land supplies the apparently exhausted substrate from which the visible reversal begins.
Life of earth through plant growth supplies the observable regeneration mechanism.
Emergence of vegetation from earth gives regeneration a concrete outward motion.
Peers grouped by form or operation expand the mechanism from one plant cycle to recurrent created types.
The focus counterpart relation receives the regenerative and type-forming mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:33-35 moves from dead earth through enlivening and emergence to edible grain and fruit.
36:36 broadens created pairings across earth, human selves, and what remains unknown.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dead-to-living earth sequence and recurrent created groupings; I infer that the visible ecology is a process analogy for human recreation, while the alternative is that it proves power without specifying how مثلهم should be understood.

changed_reading.before: A second creation is a detached repetition of the first act.
changed_reading.after: A corresponding creation can be patterned recurrence: life and kind emerge again even where the prior substrate appears spent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same surah applies creation and مثل to a rideable counterpart after naming the laden vessel. There likeness is legible through continued carrying and riding, so the focus phrase can admit functional correspondence alongside resemblance of form.

activation_trace.role: A carrying tool or mount supplies the operative function that persists across embodiments.
The water-going vessel supplies the first concrete carrier in the comparison.
Explicit counterpart language transfers likeness from bare appearance to a newly created rideable analogue.
Actual riding identifies the shared capability by which the analogue is recognized.
The same counterpart branch anchors functional equivalence back in مثلهم.

structural_cues: 36:41 names the laden vessel; 36:42 immediately says a created counterpart is something they ride.
36:42 and 36:81 share the خ ل ق plus م ث ل construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a created rideable counterpart whose continuity is operational; I infer that likeness may include preserved function across differing embodiments, while the alternative is ordinary resemblance within one vehicle class.

changed_reading.before: مثلهم requires a visually or materially duplicate human body.
changed_reading.after: مثلهم may denote a corresponding embodiment recognized also by preserved human capacities, not only by sameness of material.

context_deltas.mechanism: Long life is followed by reversal within creation. That temporal inversion turns capacity from the ability to repeat a finished manufacture into governance over the direction of embodied formation.

activation_trace.role: Extension of life supplies the temporal axis along which bodily creation changes.
Turning a thing onto its head supplies a directional reversal rather than simple cessation.
Embodied form is the domain visibly subjected to reversal over time.
Effective capacity receives the newly visible dimension of directional control.

structural_cues: 36:68 makes عمر a condition for نكس in الخلق.
The focus asks about a prospective act after naming a completed act of creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal extension followed by inversion in embodied creation; I infer that control of one developmental direction supports control of its return, while the alternative is that aging is only another power sign and not a resurrection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Capacity means being able to perform a second isolated creative act.
changed_reading.after: Capacity includes command over the temporal direction of formed life, making return from decline conceptually continuous with an already governed process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The objection isolates decayed bone as terminal material, but the surrounding sequence restores the forgotten process: a human was originated from a drop, the same bones are to be enlivened by the first originator, and every creation is known. The focus therefore answers substrate discontinuity by combining re-origination with exact knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The tiny fluid origin supplies an earlier material discontinuity already crossed in human formation.
Loss of remembered origin explains why the terminal fragment is mistaken for the whole creative history.
The person's own prior origination is the omitted precedent reintroduced by the response.
Hard bone supplies the residual bodily anchor named by the objection.
Decay and wearing-away push that residual anchor to the edge of material recognizability.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the initiating act that can be applied again.
A temporal occurrence capable of repetition turns first origination into precedent rather than a unique barrier.
Knowledge encompassing every creation prevents decay from becoming informational loss.
Counterpart likeness anchors re-origination back in the focus proposal.

structural_cues: 36:77 moves from a drop to an articulate opponent; 36:78 moves from forgotten origin to decayed bones.
36:79 answers with first origination and knowledge of every creation immediately before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies minimal origin, forgotten creation, decayed remains, first origination, and comprehensive knowledge; I infer that process history plus knowledge bridges substrate discontinuity, while a live alternative is that مثلهم still means generic replacement and only the surrounding enlivening language carries numerical identity.

changed_reading.before: The focus proposes producing a replacement member of the same species.
changed_reading.after: The focus proposes re-origination across radical material discontinuity, with known created form and history preventing the result from collapsing into a mere spare copy.

context_deltas.mechanism: A green growing tree becomes the source of ignited fire. The focus capacity claim is thereby activated as mastery of transformation across properties that appear resistant to one another, not merely repetition at a larger scale.

activation_trace.role: The living, stemmed tree supplies the material carrier of the transformation.
Tender green vegetation contributes the source state that seems remote from burning.
Kindled fire supplies the transformed state latent in the green source.
Ignition makes the transformation an enacted humanly visible process rather than an abstract possibility.
Effective capacity receives the demonstrated ability to cross an apparent material opposition.

structural_cues: 36:80 places green tree, fire, and human ignition in one source-to-output sequence.
36:81 follows immediately with the question of capacity for corresponding creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies green growth as the source of fire and ignition; I supply the arrow that treats their apparent opposition as an analogy for life after decay, while the alternative is a simpler sign of utility and power.

changed_reading.before: Recreation is plausible only if suitable living material remains.
changed_reading.after: Creative capacity includes drawing a new state from material whose visible properties seem contrary to it, so decay cannot dictate the range of possible emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah compresses will, directive speech, and occurrence into one conditional sequence. This strengthens قادر and الخلاق as unconstrained actualization: measured knowledge does not imply laborious reconstruction.

activation_trace.role: An obligating directive supplies the authoritative transition from intention to commanded result.
Occurrence and presence in time supply the realized endpoint repeated in imperative and result.
Origination in the focus receives the command-to-occurrence mechanism.
Effective capacity is strengthened as direct actualization rather than effort limited by available means.

structural_cues: 36:82 orders divine matter, desire, speech, imperative existence, and realized existence without an intervening material procedure.
It directly follows the focus affirmation بلى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, saying, imperative existence, and occurrence; I infer an efficient arrow from command to actualization, while the alternative is that the formula marks sovereignty without describing temporal mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Capacity for recreation is inferred only from the scale of an earlier manufacture.
changed_reading.after: Capacity is also the authority by which a fully known corresponding creation passes from intended possibility into occurrence without dependence on a surviving substrate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant و س م target under the focus root س م و. It remains packet-anchored through السماوات, the marking branch, العليم, and the earlier surviving آثار; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory split-root activation, not as the lexical translation of السماوات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السماوات through the packet's س م و to و س م split target, reinforced by العليم

activation_trace.role: A visible mark by which a thing is known recasts the cosmic field as legible rather than merely immense.
Distinguishing signs connect cosmic legibility to the focus epithet العليم.
A surviving trace supplies the contextual model for marks that outlast the thing's prior state.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth prove capacity only through their overwhelming scale.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cosmic merism also evokes a marked and legible creation whose distinguishing traces remain available to knowledgeable recreation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the standing branch of م ث ل is form-distant from the ordinary syntax of مثلهم. It remains anchored in the packet's branch inventory and is activated by first origination, coming forth, and final return; downstream prose should qualify it as root-level wordplay, not replace the straightforward sense of likeness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِثْلَهُم through the م ث ل branch of standing or presence, governed by يخلق

activation_trace.role: Standing and presence contribute the image of a corresponding being made to stand forth.
Coming forward and rising activates the directional image latent in standing forth.
Return to what was supplies the trajectory by which the standing counterpart reappears.

changed_reading.before: Create an equivalent object or specimen.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, create their counterpart as one made present again, standing forth along a trajectory of return.

strongest_changes: 36:12 turns العليم from a detached epithet into an identity-preserving mechanism through registration, surviving traces, and exhaustive enumeration.
36:77-79 moves مثلهم from generic duplication toward re-origination across decay, with first creation and comprehensive knowledge bridging material discontinuity.
36:80-82 adds mastery of contrary transformation and command-to-occurrence to the focus proof from cosmic scale.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed two distant recurrences that the immediate argument alone would collapse: the record-and-trace sequence of 36:12 and the functional use of خلق plus مثل for rideable counterparts in 36:41-42. These allow identity-bearing and functional readings to coexist with the direct resurrection proof.
remaining_uncertainties: مثلهم can still denote generic counterparts rather than numerical continuity of the same persons.
The bridge from rideable functional likeness to human recreation is analogical and should not displace ordinary resemblance.
The marked-cosmos and standing-forth outliers are packet-licensed lexical activations, not claims about the normal syntax of the focus phrase.
